description: A Dream of the Earth player's creature: what grows it, so it follows them to any device. One record (rkey 'self'), overwritten when they change it.

stats.description: climb, swim, run, gleam, perception (total at most 12); four values are the old fly, swim, run, gleam, read with fly as climb and no perception.

genes.description: Changes made in the editor, as in org.jason-edelman.dream.intent's creature.genes. Out-of-range or unknown fields are ignored.

updatedAt.description: When the player last changed it; on a new device the newest one they chose wins.
